Node_Text: Naphtha Rundown/ Recirculation Chiller and Light Virgin Naphtha Tanks TK-24946- 24/25
Design_Conditions: From 25134 Tank Farm Project PHA This node includes the naphtha rundown chiller from Splitter 1 and/or 2 to Light Virgin Naphtha (LVN) Tanks TK-24946-24 or TK-24946- 25. Also includes recirculation chiller which will cool the naphtha contents of Light Naphtha Tank TK-24946-24 or TK-24946-25 by recirculation through the chiller by Recirculation Pump P- 6. Normal operation may include one or two LVN tanks. Under one LVN tank operation the rundown and recirculation cooler operate on the same tank, under two tank operation, rundown and recirculation may be on the same tank or on opposite tanks. The chillers are mainly used in the summer season. The tanks' target temperature is set based on analysis of the tanks' Reid vapor pressure (RVP) and a calculation of the true vapor pressure (TVP) of the tank. Current operation is to rundown into one of two tanks and recirculate/ discharge from the other tank. Naphtha is transferred from TK-24946- 24/25 and TK-61869-15 via Naphtha Cargo Pumps P-2A/B and 38095" pipeline to Galena Park Terminal ground or water shipping area.

Also includes recirculation chiller which will cool the naphtha contents of Light Naphtha Tank TK-24946-24 or TK-24946-25 by recirculation through the chiller by Recirculation Pump P- 6. Normal operation may include one or two LVN tanks. Under one LVN tank operation the rundown and recirculation cooler operate on the same tank, under two tank operation, rundown and recirculation may be on the same tank or on opposite tanks. The chillers are mainly used in the summer season. The tanks' target temperature is set based on analysis of the tanks' Reid vapor pressure (RVP) and a calculation of the true vapor pressure (TVP) of the tank. Current operation is to rundown into one of two tanks and recirculate/ discharge from the other tank. Naphtha is transferred from TK-24946- 24/25 and TK-61869-15 via Naphtha Cargo Pumps P-2A/B and 38095" pipeline to Galena Park Terminal ground or water shipping area.

Node_Text: Feed Tank and Feed Pumps PM-53688A/B/C
Design_Conditions: From 25134 Tank Farm Project PHA This node includes Feed Tanks TK- 200-1/2/3. Normal operation is three Feed tanks with no quality difference. The plant can be fed from 12" Magellan line to all three tanks and TK-61869-14 and a 35796" Kinder Morgan Condensate Crude KMCC line to all three tanks and TK-61869- 14. The Magellan line also includes a pig launcher that is operated by Galena Park. The pig launcher on the KMCC line is not operated by Galena Park. Feed can be transferred between Feed Tanks via Pump P-HX which send feed through the AGO Exchanger HX1/2. Feed Pumps PM- 111A/B/C send Feed to Splitter 1/2 from TK-97415-1/2/3. Feed can be transferred from TK-61869-14 to TK- 200-1/2/3 via P-7 and then through P-HX also through the AGO Exchanger HX1/2 which will be review in node 7. This node also includes the hydrocarbon header which is a maintenance drain from the splitter, removes liquid from flare knockout drum and is the relief header for the Feed Pumps PM- 111A/B/C thermal safeties. TK-97415-1/200-3: - Capacity = 200,130 Atm BBl - MDMT = 30 degF - Max Temp = 200 degF
